# notify

```go
import "github.com/shdeen/saferm/internal/notify"
```

Package notify carries the IDs of actions that await review to the optional SafeRM Notify program, over a loopback connection. It has no desktop dependencies and never starts SafeRM Notify.

<a name="Send"></a>
## func Send

```go
func Send(ctx context.Context, home string, actionID int64) error
```

Send delivers the action ID to the listener that the endpoint file under the home directory publishes. It returns nil without sending when there is no endpoint file or when nothing listens at the endpoint. It returns ErrInputInvalid for a nonpositive ID and for an endpoint that has no token or is not on the loopback address.

<a name="Listen"></a>
### func Listen

```go
func Listen(ctx context.Context, home string) (*Listener, error)
```

Listen opens a listener on a loopback port and publishes its address, with a newly generated token, in the endpoint file under the home directory.

<a name="Listener.Close"></a>
### func \(\*Listener\) Close

```go
func (listener *Listener) Close() error
```

Close closes the listener and removes its endpoint file.

<a name="Listener.Receive"></a>
### func \(\*Listener\) Receive

```go
func (listener *Listener) Receive() (int64, error)
```

Receive waits for the next message and returns its action ID. It returns ErrInputInvalid for a message with the wrong token or a nonpositive ID, and an error that wraps net.ErrClosed once the listener is closed.
